items.title: Capital One Financial Corp's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Capital One Financial Corp (NYSE:COF) recently announced a total dividend of $0.8 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-17.  This includes a cash dividend of $0.8 per share payable on 2026-09-01.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.

items.title: Sam Stovall’s Warning: Consumer Spending Will Collapse the Moment Banks Tighten Credit
items.summary: Sam Stovall says sentiment surveys are a distraction and that one specific corner of the financial system holds the real on-off switch for consumer spending. The signals hiding in this earnings season will tell investors whether that switch is about to flip.

items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks with Open Questions
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.
